name: lifecycle
description: The full ticket-to-review lifecycle as callable skills: frame, grill, spec, plan, plan-check, deliver, ship and babysit, plus tdd, diagnose, resolve-conflicts and show, and the four sub-agents they dispatch. The session builds every task itself; fresh agents only review — risky tasks, UI screenshots, and the whole diff at the end. Optional review tiers put a signed-off walkthrough before the build and another after it. Type /advance and it runs whichever phase comes next. Reads how your repo works — gates, tracker, forge and ship mode, preview, naming, reviewers and the per-call effort budget — from nine files under .agents/, written by /onboard.
